description:
About our brand and products: CrinklePak is a specialty supplier of premium crinkle paper and shredded paper filler for gift baskets, packaging, and unboxing experiences. Our filler is available in both 10 lb and 40 lb boxes, from everyday solids like red, blue, pink, ivory, black, and gray, to eye-catching metallics and iridescents, plus seasonal favorites like Christmas, Halloween, Candy Cane, Easter Grass, and Spring Mix. Whether for small businesses, subscription boxes, gift shops, or DIY crafters, CrinklePak adds color, cushioning, and a beautiful finishing touch to any package.

What makes us different:We focus on doing one thing exceptionally well: high-quality crinkle paper at scale. Customers get vibrant, consistent color, generous bulk box sizes (10 lb and 40 lb) that deliver real value, and one of the widest color and seasonal ranges available — so they can match any brand palette, holiday, or occasion. Our paper-based filler is a practical, attractive way to protect and present products.

How affiliates can earn: Affiliates earn a 15% commission on every qualifying sale generated through their unique referral link. Cookies last for 30 days, so you get credit even when customers come back to buy later. With bulk box sizes and repeat-purchase customers like gift basket makers and subscription brands, there's strong potential for recurring orders and higher average order values. 

How to promote us: Share your referral link wherever your audience is — blogs, YouTube unboxing or DIY craft videos, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and email newsletters. CrinklePak is a natural fit for content about gift wrapping, gift basket tutorials, small-business packaging, subscription box design, seasonal crafts, and ecommerce shipping tips. Product photos, color swatches, and seasonal collections make for easy, visual, shareable content.
